decisions.reason: It survived the initial screening through 2019 with a dedicated product page, so as a large established manufacturer we would keep this option open because its market potential appears not yet disproven and the carrying cost is likely manageable.
This product also retained a standalone page through 2019, indicating stronger commitment and enough promise to justify continued commercialization rather than early abandonment.

Its weaker website presence suggests a smaller or more uncertain opportunity, but since it remained listed after launch and likely costs relatively little to maintain, we would keep it for now while monitoring demand.

Because this hearing-protection earmold line stayed on the website while a related earmold line was removed, it appears to be the more viable niche and worth retaining unless clearer negative evidence emerges.
